name: property-crm
description: Property Management CRM — properties, units, tenants, leases, rent, maintenance and reports in one place.

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
